newsitem.title: USA: Marriott International increases its div.
newsitem.headline: Marriott International increases its div.

text.p: Marriott International Inc said Friday it increased its quarterly dividend by 13 percent to $0.09 per share from $0.08 per share.
The dividend is payable July 17 to shareholders of record on June 27.

J.W. Marriott, chairman and chief executive officer, said, "Our business is strong and our profits continue to grow, so we believe an increase in our dividend rate is well justified. At the same time, we continue to expect to reinvest the majority of our earnings to pursue global growth opportunities, like our recent acquisition of Renaissance Hotel Group NV."

Marriott International is a hospitality company, which operates and franchises the Marriott, Ritz-Carlton, Courtyard, Residence Inn, Fairfield, TownePlace Suites, Renaissance, New World, Ramada International and Marriott Executive Residences hotel brands.
